definitions.de: Halten, tragen, in der Hand halten; etwas mit den Händen festhalten oder bei sich tragen
definitions.en: To hold, carry, or grasp; to keep something in one's hands or to carry something on one's person
definitions.es: Sostener, cargar, sujetar; tener algo en las manos o llevar algo consigo
definitions.fr: Tenir, porter, saisir; garder quelque chose dans les mains ou transporter quelque chose sur soi
definitions.hi: पकड़ना, थामना, उठाना; कुछ हाथों में रखना या अपने साथ लेकर चलना
definitions.ja: 持つ、握る、抱える；手の中に何かを保持したり、身につけて運んだりする
definitions.km: កាន់, ប្រដាប់, យក; ដៃកាន់អ្វីមួយ ឬនាំយ៉ាងអ្វីមួយទៅជាមួយខ្លួន
definitions.ko: 들다, 잡다, 쥐다, 들고 다니다; 무언가를 손에 쥐고 있거나 몸에 지니고 다니다
definitions.ne: समात्नु, बोक्नु, थाम्नु; केही हातमा राख्नु वा आफूसँग लिएर हिँड्नु
definitions.pt: Segurar, carregar, pegar; manter algo nas mãos ou carregar algo consigo
definitions.th: ถือ, จับ, อุ้ม; จับหรือพกพาสิ่งของไว้ในมือหรือติดตัว
definitions.tl: Hawakan, bitbitin, dalhin; hawakan ang isang bagay sa mga kamay o magdala ng isang bagay
definitions.ur: پکڑنا، تھامنا، اٹھانا؛ کسی چیز کو ہاتھوں میں رکھنا یا اپنے ساتھ لے کر چلنا
definitions.vi: Cầm, giữ, mang; giữ thứ gì đó trong tay hoặc mang theo bên người
definitions.zh: 拿，握，持；用手拿着某物或随身携带某物
definitions.zh_Hant: 拿，握，持；用手拿著某物或隨身攜帶某物

definition_en: To hold, carry, or grasp; to keep something in one's hands or to carry something on one's person
